works.body:
Hello! I came across your work on X and I really liked how you draw backgrounds! So I would like to request you to draw my characters! ^^ My reference sheets are below. Raven is a black-haired girl who is very playful and often/loves to tease Cain. She's a bit bratty and likes to pull tricks on him, and a bit obsessed too. The other character is Cain. He is serious but gets shy easily. He likes to sleep a lot. They are a couple! You can decide the pose and expression based on the information and references! If you don't feel comfortable with my request, please cancel I will understand. Thank you for considering my request~
